title: Restaurant Review Analysis Report
executive_summary: An analysis of 214 customer reviews for Epic Pizza & Subs revealed key operational pain points primarily centered around food quality consistency, staff attitude, long wait times, and perceived value for money. Addressing these areas through targeted operational, training, and menu adjustments will significantly improve guest satisfaction.
key_findings: Negative reviews regarding food quality appeared in approximately 17.7% of the analyzed sample.
Negative feedback on staff attitude and customer service was present in roughly 14.5% of reviews.
Dissatisfaction with pricing and value for money was noted in 8.8% of reviews.
Complaints regarding long wait times affected about 6.5% of reviewers.

root_causes.cause: Inconsistent kitchen execution, potentially due to high turnover or lack of strict quality control during peak hours.

root_causes.pattern: Negative feedback on staff attitude and customer service
root_causes.cause: Understaffing leading to employee burnout, poor morale, and lack of adequate customer service training.

root_causes.pattern: Dissatisfaction with pricing and value for money
root_causes.cause: Perceived mismatch between portion sizes or food quality and the price points set by the establishment.
Kitchen and front-of-house bottlenecking during busy periods, pointing to operational inefficiency or poor table management.

recommendations.issue: Inconsistent kitchen execution and poor food quality during peak hours
recommendations.action: Implement strict standardization recipes, station checklists, and a mandatory head-chef quality control check before any plate leaves the kitchen.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in food-related complaints and improved consistency across all services.

recommendations.issue: Staff burnout, poor morale, and negative customer service attitude due to understaffing
recommendations.action: Revise staff scheduling to ensure adequate coverage during peak hours, and introduce a mandatory customer service training workshop alongside an incentive program for positive reviews.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved staff morale, friendlier guest interactions, and a noticeable drop in service complaints.

recommendations.issue: Kitchen and front-of-house bottlenecks causing long wait times
recommendations.action: Optimize the floor plan and adopt a digital table management and POS-integrated kitchen display system (KDS) to streamline communication between servers and line cooks.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster table turns, reduced wait times, and improved overall throughput during rushes.

recommendations.issue: Perceived mismatch between portion sizes, quality, and menu prices
recommendations.action: Conduct a menu engineering audit to either slightly increase portion sizes on underperforming items or refine menu descriptions to better set customer expectations regarding value.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced perceived value for money, leading to better customer satisfaction scores on pricing.

limitations: Analysis is limited to a sample size of 214 reviews which may introduce selection bias towards highly satisfied or highly dissatisfied customers.
Online reviews lack contextual nuances such as specific times of visit or individual customer expectations.
